content.rendered:
The Bride Who Has Everything – 5 meaningful gifts, 5 stories worth keeping

There’s a particular kind of gift guilt that shows up before a wedding. She’s registered for the essentials. Her home is already coming together. Her friends have already given her jewelry, art, everything a life seems to need.

So the question isn’t what she’s missing. It’s what she’ll still have, and still feel, long after the wedding day has folded itself into memory.

These five picks aren’t about novelty. They’re about permanence — and each one comes from a maker whose story is worth knowing.

Earrings, by Jihan C

Architectural jewelry inspired by Middle Eastern design. A timeless bridal gift.

Jihan Chehayeb is an architect first, a jeweler second — and it shows. Her pieces began as bookmarks, designed to carry the shape of Middle Eastern landmarks into daily life.

Every piece still carries that architectural instinct: windows, arches, and doorways reimagined as gold. A pair of Jihan C earrings is chosen because it holds a piece of history in its shape — something to wear on ordinary days long after the wedding photos are framed.

 

Wall art, by Rawan Sirry

Handmade sculptural artwork adding a unique touch to modern homes.

Rawan Sirry works in a medium most people don’t expect: clay, shaped into miniature sculptures she calls her “chocolates.” Her first piece, made on Valentine’s Day, was a quiet joke on desire and indulgence — and it opened into a body of work now sitting in collectors’ homes.

A new home asks for something on its walls that isn’t a print picked in a hurry. A piece by Rawan Sirry gives the couple’s space a first work of art with a point of view — playful, tactile, and entirely hers.

 

A handwritten family recipe, by Artlet Studio

A favorite recipe, passed down and made to last.

Not every gift needs to be new. Artlet Studio works with something a bride already has — a treasured family recipe, kept in its original handwriting — and turns it into a keepsake worth framing.

It’s a gift that reaches backward into her family, right as she’s building one of her own. The sentiment does the work; the craft just makes sure it lasts.

 

A signature serving tray, by Maison Remie

A handcrafted serving piece blending heritage craftsmanship with modern design.

Behind Maison Remie is a personal story: the founder has spoken about learning embroidery at her grandmother’s hands, and building the brand as a way to honor that artistry and keep the technique alive. It’s why every piece carries embroidery not as decoration, but as a kind of inheritance.

Maison Remie’s brass serving tray comes from their “Brass Meets Embroidery” collection, where solid brass is paired with hand-stitched geometric embroidery. It’s a pairing that sums up the brand: heritage craftsmanship read through a modern, minimal lens.

Registries are full of full sets. What’s rarer is one object worth reaching for again and again — a brass tray with enough weight and presence to hold the coffee on a slow Sunday, or the small dinners that happen long after the wedding guests have gone home.

 

Pure rose oil, by Baheeya

A timeless fragrance crafted from hand-harvested rose petals.

Baheeya is an Omani brand, and its rose oil follows a tradition as old as the mountains it comes from: petals harvested by hand, one at a time, at the moment their scent is at its peak. It’s slow work, the kind that can’t be rushed by machinery — which is part of why the oil holds its fragrance so well.

Scent has a way of holding a day in place. A pure rose oil from Baheeya can become the thing she associates with this exact season of her life — quietly present on her skin, long after the rest of the day has become memory.

 

A gift for the bride who has everything isn’t about finding something she doesn’t have. It’s about giving her something — and someone’s story — she’ll still reach for.

content.rendered:
THE YALLA SUMMER EDIT: SIX PIECES TO GIFT, WEAR & LOVE

A curated selection of summer pieces chosen for effortless days, sunlit escapes, and thoughtful gifting.

There’s a particular kind of light that only shows up in summer — golden, unhurried, made for long afternoons and longer goodbyes at the shore. It’s the season for showing up softly: in linen, in color, in pieces that feel like they were chosen with care. This is our summer gift edit — six finds worth giving, and worth keeping for yourself.

The Hat — Fiordea

Shade, styled, and handmade to prove it.

Why we love it: A great hat does more than shield you from the sun — it sets the tone before you’ve said a word. Fiordea’s straw hats are handmade, each one carrying the small imperfections that come with real craft. Effortless by design, considered by hand.

 

The Scarf — Zali the Brand

One scarf, endless ways to wear the sun.

Why we love it: The scarf moves the way summer does — light, breezy, a little unpredictable. It can be tied over swimwear, styled with a simple dress, or packed as that final detail that changes the whole look. It’s the detail that turns simple into considered.

 

The Kaftan — Poccaa by Alia

Timeless, by definition.

Why we love it: Some silhouettes never go out of season. Poccaa by Alia’s classic kaftan is fluid, unfussy, and quietly luxurious — the kind of piece that carries you from beach to dinner without a second thought.

 

The Dresses — Nur Official, SS26 Collection

Newness, done right.

Why we love it: Some summer dresses are made for plans. Others are made for the feeling before the plan even begins.

The SS26 dresses from NUR Official bring that soft holiday energy — feminine, light, and ready for long lunches, summer evenings, and suitcase moments that need very little styling.

This is the collection that brings a rare mix of fresh and familiar — dresses built for warm weather living, with just enough detail to feel special.

 

The Beach Bag — Bu Towels

Everything you need, nothing you don’t.

Why we love it: A good beach bag is a love letter to simplicity. Bu Towels gets the balance right — roomy, relaxed, and beautifully made, while reflecting Bu Towels’ commitment to more responsible, sustainable choices. The only thing you’re thinking about is where to go next.

 

The Beach Towel — Narrae

Every towel is a canvas, and every canvas tells a story.

Why we love it: Each Narrae collection is built around a human emotion, brought to life by artists from around the world who choose that feeling and illustrate their own story onto the towel. It’s less an accessory, more a small piece of art you take with you — one that carries a hidden pocket for essentials and side snaps that let it double as a poncho or sarong. It’s made with a mindful approach to beauty, function, and sustainability. Wrap it, wear it, lay it down by the water — either way, you’re carrying someone’s story with you.

Yalla Together — curated for the season, made for the moment.

content.rendered:
A Father’s Day edit of meaningful gifts, chosen with intention

Editor’s Note

Finding a meaningful Father’s Day gift in 2026 shouldn’t feel like a compromise between what looks good and what actually says something. There’s a particular kind of father most of us know — the one who says “don’t get me anything” and genuinely means it. Who still uses the same watch from twenty years ago, not because he can’t afford a new one, but because it was a gift, and that matters to him. This Father’s Day, we’re not here to add to the noise of obvious options. We’re here to help you find something true

The Edit

 01 — Wear This Wish

The Azza Fahmy Protector Bracelet

A wearable wish for health and protection: simple, meaningful, and timeless

Some gifts speak before you say a word. The Protector Bracelet from Egypt’s most revered fine jewelry house, Azza Fahmy, is one of them. Woven leather and twisted sterling silver meet at a clasp inscribed with Arabic calligraphy: لصاحبه العافية — Good health to the wearer. Three words that carry the weight of every prayer a family has ever whispered quietly.

In 1969, Azza Fahmy became the first woman in Egypt to apprentice with the master craftsmen of Khan El Khalili, Cairo’s historic jewellery quarter. More than five decades later, her house continues to honour ancient craft while giving it a contemporary voice.

Handcrafted by skilled artisans in Cairo, her pieces carry a lineage of craft that predates modern luxury by centuries. But what makes this piece remarkable is not its materials alone — it is what it carries.

A wish, quietly given.

Health. Longevity. Ease.

The kind of gift that says the person who chose it was not simply thinking of what to buy, but of what to wish for him.

 

02 — The Detail That Says Everything

Zaid by Zaid Farouki Brooch

Identity, pinned. Let the brooch do the talking

There is a man who dresses without fuss — a dark blazer, a crisp shirt, nothing more — and who looks precisely right because of it. For that man, a Zaid Farouki brooch is not an accessory. It is a punctuation mark.

Palestinian-Jordanian designer Zaid Farouki studied in Milan and London before opening his Dubai atelier, where he designs pieces that exist at the intersection of heritage and the unconventional. His brooches are inspired by regional photographs and traditional adornment, reimagined through handcrafted details, crystals, and fine metalwork.

To give a Zaid Farouki brooch is to give something that carries culture, craft, and the careful eye of a designer who believes that where you come from belongs on your lapel with pride. It’s the detail that transforms an ordinary Tuesday into something quietly distinguished.

03 — The Gift of Rest

BON CHARGE Blue Light Blocking Glasses

A simple tool for better sleep designed to reduce screen light exposure and support natural rest at night

He’s the last one to sleep. After the late news, the scrolling, the emails he swore he’d stop checking. What his body experiences isn’t rest — it’s interrupted recovery, because the light from every screen in the house is telling his brain, in the language of wavelengths, that it is still midday.

BON CHARGE (formerly BLUblox) engineered a solution grounded not in wellness marketing but in peer-reviewed science. Their blue light blocking glasses filter 100% of the blue and green light spectrum between 400–550nm — precisely the frequencies clinically shown to suppress melatonin production and disrupt the body’s circadian rhythm. Worn in the two to three hours before bed, they allow the brain to begin its natural wind-down while the evening continues as normal.

This is the gift for the father who won’t go to bed earlier — but who deserves to sleep deeper when he finally does. It asks nothing of him except to put them on. The rest happens without effort.

In a world of unnecessary supplements and elaborate routines, this is the rare thing: a simple object, backed by science, that genuinely works.

 

 04 — One Watch. Five Stories.

LX Dubai Signature Collection Watch Strap Set

The same piece, redefined for different moments

His watch has been on his wrist for years. The strap is original, faithful, unchanged. And this is exactly why a considered set of replacement straps from LX Dubai is the gift that reframes something he already loves — without asking him to let it go.

The Signature Collection comes as a curated set of three or five straps, each one crafted to give the same case a completely different register.

Aged leather for Sunday mornings. A structured darker strap for the office. Something lighter for summer. A watch collector doesn’t collect watches — he collects possibilities for the same watch.

Born and built in Dubai, LX Dubai sits in the tradition of fine watch strap craft: precise sizing, quality materials, the kind of finish that signals knowledge rather than display. For the father whose watch is the one object he has truly kept — this gift says: I see what that means to you. Here’s more of it.

 

 05 — The Book Only You Could Write

Dad, I Wrote a Book About You (Fill-in Prompts Journal)

A simple gift, chosen for the meaning it carries

Every other gift in this edit can be given by anyone with good taste and a browser. This one cannot. This is the one that costs the least and means the most.

Dad, I Wrote a Book About You by M.H. Clark is a fill-in-the-blank journal — a structured space for children (of any age) to answer prompts that become, in the filling, a portrait of a person only they know. My favorite memory with you is ___. You always make me feel ___. The thing you’ve taught me that I still carry is ___. 

Page by page, handwriting by handwriting, a book takes shape that no shop in the world could have made.

We include this not despite its simplicity, but because of it. In a guide about substance over status, this is the purest expression of that principle. The father who says he needs nothing will hold this and understand immediately that it is not a gift you bought. It is a gift you made — and that is the only kind that lasts.

A Note on How We Choose

Every brand in a Yalla Together edit is chosen by hand. We look for meaning, craft, intention, and stories worth sharing — from women-led houses and thoughtful makers to products made to last, not pass.

We don’t take paid placements. We take our time.

Azza Fahmy carries heritage through jewellery. Zaid Farouki turns regional identity into contemporary design. BON CHARGE approaches wellness with evidence, not performance. LX Dubai preserves the quiet craft of fine straps. And the prompt journal reminds us that love, when written down, becomes something to keep.

The Gift Isn’t the Thing. It’s the Knowing.

For the fathers who say they need nothing, the right gift is rarely the loudest or most expensive. It is the one that says: I noticed. I know you. And that is worth marking.

Happy Father’s Day!

From Yalla Together

content.rendered:
A gift to mark his time, and a letter to guide his journey.

Graduation is one of those meaningful milestones where time suddenly feels visible.

You look at your son and see every version of him at once: the little boy who once held your hand, the young man standing tall today, and the future he is about to step into with courage, confidence, and possibility.

For this edition of Letters with Gifts, we pair a heartfelt graduation letter to a son with one meaningful gift:

D1 Milano watch from Ounass

A watch is more than something to wear. It is a reminder of time, growth, discipline, and the quiet power of moving forward. With its modern design and confident style, the D1 Milano watch feels like a thoughtful graduation gift for a son entering a new chapter of life.

It is a gift that says: your time is yours now. Use it well. Wear it with pride. Let it remind you of who you are, where you come from, and everything still ahead.

The Letter

My dearest son,

Today, we celebrate your graduation.

But more than that, we celebrate the years that brought you here — the learning, the patience, the effort, the challenges, and the small victories that shaped you along the way.

I have watched you grow, not only in age, but in character. I have seen your strength become quieter, your choices become wiser, and your dreams begin to take their own shape.

This watch is my gift to you, but also my reminder.

Time is one of life’s greatest blessings. It will teach you, test you, surprise you, and guide you. Some moments will feel fast, others slow. Some days will bring clarity, others uncertainty. But through every season, remember that you carry within you the values, love, and strength that brought you this far.

Wear this watch as a reminder to respect your time, to trust your journey, and to never rush becoming the person you are meant to be.

May you use your time with purpose.

May you be brave enough to begin again when life asks you to.

May you stay kind, even when the world feels busy.

May you work hard, but never forget to live fully.

May you always know that success is not only measured by what you achieve, but by the person you become along the way.

As you step into this new chapter, I hope you remember this: you do not need to have every answer today. You only need to keep moving with honesty, courage, and an open heart.

I am proud of you — not only for graduating, but for growing into the young man you are.

This is your time, my son.

Honor it. Enjoy it. Make it meaningful.

With all my love,

Mom/Dad

A Gift to Mark His Time: D1 Milano watch from Ounass

A D1 Milano watch: More than a watch, a symbol of growth, purpose, and the journey ahead.

 

A D1 Milano watch makes a thoughtful graduation gift for a son because it carries both style and meaning. It is modern, refined, and easy to wear, but its deeper message is what makes it memorable.

For a graduate, a watch becomes a symbol of a new beginning. It marks the transition from one chapter to the next, reminding him that time is now something he will shape with his own choices, dreams, and direction.

Paired with a personal letter, the gift becomes more than a graduation present. It becomes a keepsake — a reminder of love, pride, and the beautiful responsibility of stepping into the future.

From Yalla Together, congratulations to every graduate stepping into a new chapter. May this milestone mark the beginning of a life shaped with purpose, courage, and meaningful moments.

title: A MEANINGFUL GRADUATION GIFT FOR A DAUGHTER: A LETTER WITH THE CLASSIC BANGLE CUFF FROM USFUUR
excerpt: Graduation is a tender milestone — a celebration of how far your child has come, and a gentle reminder of how far she is ready to go. For this edition of Letters with Gifts, we pair a heartfelt graduation letter to a daughter with one meaningful piece: the Classic Bangle Cuff from Usfuur. content.rendered:
A letter with a gift for your daughter’s graduation, to celebrate her journey and what lies ahead

Graduation is a tender milestone — a celebration of how far your child has come, and a gentle reminder of how far she is ready to go.

For this edition of Letters with Gifts, we pair a heartfelt graduation letter to a daughter with one meaningful piece: the Classic Bangle Cuff from Usfuur.

More than a beautiful piece of jewelry, this graduation gift carries a message of freedom, courage, belonging, and new beginnings — making it a thoughtful keepsake for a daughter stepping into her next chapter.

The Classic Bangle Cuff from Usfuur

The Letter

My dearest daughter,

Today, we celebrate more than your graduation.

We celebrate the years of learning, trying, growing, and becoming. We celebrate the quiet moments of effort no one always saw, the courage it took to keep going, and the beautiful person you continue to become.

This gift is my reminder to you: let your wings unfold.

Let life take you to new places, new dreams, and new versions of yourself. Do not be afraid of distance, change, or unfamiliar paths. Just like birds, we are meant to move beyond borders — to discover, to connect, and to carry beauty with us wherever we go.

May this bangle remind you that home is not only a place. It is the love you carry, the values that guide you, and the people who will always be cheering for you from wherever they are.

Wear it as a small symbol of your freedom, your courage, and the beautiful journey ahead.

Rise, my love — with grace, strength, and an open heart.

I am endlessly proud of you.

With all my love,

Mama / Papa

⸻

The Gift: Classic Bangle Cuff from Usfuur

A timeless bangle cuff from Usfuur

 

The Classic Bangle Cuff from Usfuur is a meaningful graduation gift for a daughter stepping into a new chapter in life.

Inspired by the spirit of birds, the piece reflects the idea that we can rise above boundaries, move beyond borders, and stay connected through beauty, style, and shared meaning. For a graduate, this message feels especially fitting. It speaks to independence, movement, courage, and the freedom to explore the world while still carrying a deep sense of belonging.

It is a gift she can wear as she begins her next journey — a quiet reminder that she is free to grow, dream, and go far.

What makes this bangle even more meaningful is the purpose behind Usfuur. Through each piece, the brand gives back to help support a displaced child in need through art, education, and community-driven initiatives.

Why It Makes a Thoughtful Graduation Gift

A graduation gift for a daughter does not always need to be extravagant to feel special. Sometimes, one meaningful piece is enough — especially when it carries a message she can return to again and again.
The Classic Bangle Cuff is a keepsake she can wear beyond graduation day. It marks the moment, holds the memory, and reminds her of the love, strength, and encouragement surrounding her as she steps into the future.
From Yalla Together, congratulations to every graduate! May the next chapter unfold with courage, grace, and beauty.

content.rendered:
Sustainable Eid Host Gifts: Meaningful Gestures for Eid Gatherings

Eid Al Adha is a season of gathering, generosity, and warm hospitality. It is the time of long family lunches, evening visits, shared coffee, and homes filled with people we love.

And when you are invited to someone’s home, the gift you bring can say more than “thank you.” It can carry appreciation, care, and a sense of thoughtfulness.

This year, consider Eid host gifts that are beautiful, useful, and meaningful. From artisan-made table pieces to sustainable home accents and gifts with cultural stories, these ideas are made for the moments that bring people together.

For the Table That Brings Everyone Together

Otbé placemats and/or napkins

A beautifully set table for meaningful Eid gatherings

A set of placemats and/or napkins from Otbé is more than a table accessory. It is a gift for the host who takes joy in creating a warm and beautiful table.

Made by skilled artisans using fine sustainable materials, these pieces matter because they celebrate craft, slow design, and the beauty of reusable hosting essentials.

They are perfect for the host who loves thoughtful details — the mother setting the Eid lunch table, the friend hosting dinner, or the family member who always makes guests feel welcome.

This gift belongs to the heart of the Eid gathering: the table. It carries the message, may your home always be full, warm, and beautifully gathered.

 

Set of seven coffee cups from Kashida

A coffee set rooted in culture and hospitality

The set of seven coffee cups from Kashida, with each cup reflecting one of the seven Emirates, turns a familiar hospitality ritual into something more meaningful.

This gift matters because Arabic coffee is never just coffee. It is a symbol of welcome, conversation, and connection. With each cup representing an Emirate, the set also carries a quiet celebration of the UAE and its culture of hospitality.

It is perfect for the host who loves serving coffee, appreciates design with meaning, or enjoys pieces that start a conversation.

This gift belongs to the moment after the meal — when guests sit, talk, sip coffee, and stay a little longer. It carries the message, your hospitality is part of the story of this place.

 

For the Home with a Story

Candle from Innara

Warm light with a meaningful story

A candle from Innara brings warmth into the home, but its story makes it even more special. Made using construction waste, it transforms discarded materials into something beautiful and purposeful.

This gift matters because it shows how sustainability can be elegant. It reminds us that beauty can come from rethinking what already exists, giving materials a second life instead of letting them go to waste.

It is perfect for the host who loves home fragrance, meaningful design, and pieces with a conscious story.

This gift belongs to the quiet evening moments of Eid — after the guests have left, when the home is calm and the candle is lit. It carries the message, may your home always hold warmth, light, and renewed beauty.

 

Naskh Planter Pot in hand-drawn calligraphy from Plntd

A handcrafted planter that brings greenery, calm, and life into the home

A customized pot with a plant from Plntd is a fresh and lasting alternative to flowers. It brings greenery into the home and continues to grow long after Eid has passed.

This gift matters because it feels personal and alive. While many gifts are enjoyed for a moment, a plant becomes part of the home — a gentle reminder of the occasion and the person who gifted it.

It is perfect for a host, family member, friend, or anyone who loves simple home details and meaningful gestures.

This gift belongs to the arrival moment — when you walk in with something fresh, personal, and thoughtful in your hands. It carries the message, may your home continue to grow with love, care, and blessings.

 

For Her Moments of Rest

Exfoliating hand wash and body lotion

A moment of rest after hosting

A thoughtful Eid host gift for someone who gives so much of herself to others. Made with Dead Sea minerals, this Salt & Mud gift box brings together an exfoliating hand wash and body lotion.

What makes it special, however, is not only what is inside, but the moment it belongs to: the quiet pause after the guests leave, when the host finally gets to slow down and care for herself.

Ultimately, this box carries a gentle message: your care is seen, and now it is your turn to be cared for.

 

For a Meaningful Personal Gesture

Handcrafted misbaha bracelet from Basmala Beads

A small gift with lasting meaning

The Traveller Misbaha bracelet from Basmala Beads is a gift that feels both personal and spiritual. As a wearable misbaha, it carries intention, reflection, and everyday meaning.

This gift matters because it is not only something to wear. It is a companion for daily moments of remembrance, gratitude, and grounding — especially during a season rooted in faith and reflection.

It is perfect for someone who appreciates meaningful jewelry, spiritual gifts, or pieces that blend beauty with purpose.

This gift belongs to the quieter side of Eid — the personal prayers, the reflections, the moments between gatherings. It carries the message, may you be surrounded by peace, protection, and remembrance wherever you go.

A More Thoughtful Way to Gift This Eid Al Adha

Sustainable Eid gifting is not only about what a gift is made from. It is also about what it means, how it is used, and the story it leaves behind.

A table piece can honor gathering. A coffee cup can celebrate hospitality. A candle can give discarded materials a second life. A plant can keep growing after the visit. A self-care box can offer rest. A misbaha bracelet can carry reflection and intention.

This Eid Al Adha, choose host gifts that feel generous in more than one way — gifts with purpose, story, and heart.

 

Wishing you a blessed Eid al Adha, filled with warmth, togetherness, and thoughtful gestures. 

Eid Mubarak!

content.rendered:
The May Mood Edit: Thoughtful Gifts for the Season Before Summer

May in the UAE carries a mood of its own. The days are warmer, summer plans begin to take shape, and the rhythm of school, work, gatherings, and home slowly shifts indoors. It is the month of small resets — lighter textures, cooler drinks, softer routines, and thoughtful gestures before the full summer heat arrives.

This edition gathers proudly created brands in the UAE that reflect the spirit of the season: everyday cooling essentials, soft seasonal layers, creative gifts for children, elegant host gestures, and meaningful home accents.

Most of the pieces also carry a more sustainable touch – making them not only beautiful to give, but more thoughtful in the way they are chosen.

 

For the One Who Loves Everyday Little Luxuries

A set of silk scrunchies from LOVESPUN

These silk scrunchies blend everyday practicality with a soft, elegant touch.

Some gifts do not need to be grand to feel special. A set of silk scrunchies from LOVESPUN makes a simple yet elegant gift – gentle on the hair, easy to use, and perfect for warmer days when hair is often tied back. It is the kind of practical beauty gift that feels thoughtful without being too formal.

 

For the One Who Loves Effortless Elegance

A soft Kaftan from Pamukme

Some pieces speak through their simplicity, and this kaftan is one of them.

A soft Kaftan from Pamukme brings an elevated look to a simple outfit through its beautifully versatile, light and fluid style, adding softness and grace. It makes a lovely gift for someone who appreciates pieces that feel relaxed yet refined – easy to wear, easy to style, and perfect for the season before summer.

 

For the One Always Carrying a Drink

An insulated tumbler from Loch Life

A sleek insulated tumbler keeps drinks cool while bringing a practical, sustainable touch to everyday routines

An insulated tumbler from Loch Life makes a thoughtful gift for anyone moving through busy days, school runs, office hours, or weekend plans.

Designed with everyday use in mind, it encourages a more sustainable alternative to single-use cups and bottles, while keeping drinks cool through the warmer days.

It is practical, polished, and perfectly in tune with the pre-summer season.

 

For Little Ones in the Almost-Summer Mood

The matching bamboo clothing for kids from Beauxdesert

Bringing comfort, playfulness and a thoughtful touch to little wardrobes

The matching bamboo clothing for kids from Beauxdesert it’s soft, breathable, and gentle for warmer days. Crafted from bamboo, it brings a more conscious approach to children’s clothing while still feeling playful and comfortable.

It is a lovely choice for siblings, cousins, or little ones who love matching moments.

Even more meaningful, with each order, one tree is planted – adding a thoughtful impact beyond the gift itself.

 

A non-toxic playdough kit from Tiny Treasures by Bambino

 

This non-toxic playdough kit brings calm, screen-free fun to warm, slow afternoons

For a more playful gift, a non-toxic playdough kit from Tiny Treasures by Bambino offers exactly the kind of indoor activity parents appreciate as the weather gets hotter. It gives children a chance to create, shape, imagine, and unwind – without screens and without too much noise.

These are gifts that understand May for families: the tired end-of-school-year energy, the need for gentle play, and the desire for soft, easy pieces that work beautifully before summer begins.

 

For the Host Before Everyone Travels

May often becomes the month of “let’s meet before summer.” Family lunches, casual dinners, and small gatherings start to feel more meaningful before travel season begins.

A tray filled with dates from Fyruzi

A gift rooted in tradition and quiet elegance

A tray filled with dates from Fyruzi makes a refined and thoughtful host gift. Dates always feel generous, familiar, and beautifully rooted in local hospitality. It comes with a handcrafted ceramic tray – a gift that begins with sweetness and stays as a keepsake.

 

A handmade crochet flower basket from Ghanis Knot

A bouquet that lasts…

A handmade crochet flower basket from Ghanis Knot brings a soft, sustainable touch to the May edition. Crafted by hand, it feels thoughtful, charming, and full of character. Its crochet design makes it more lasting alternative to a traditional bouquet. It’s perfect for a host, mom, a friend or anyone who appreciates handmade gifts with warmth and meaning.

 

A handmade terracotta jug from Ark Naturals

A handmade terracotta jug blending natural charm with everyday function

A handmade terracotta jug from Ark Naturals makes a beautiful host gift with a warm, earthy feel. Crafted by hand, it brings natural charm to the table and feels especially suited to warmer months. Terracotta is known for helping keep water cool on summer days, making it both a thoughtful and practical piece to have at home.

These gifts feel ideal for the person who gathers everyone, the family member hosting lunch, or anyone who appreciates handmade pieces, natural materials and tablewares with a story.

 

For the One Who Loves Gifts With a Story

A handmade natural soap from Keniskhan

A handmade natural soap: a small but meaningful gift that brings beauty to everyday rituals.

A handmade natural soap from Keniskhan is a lovely reminder that simple rituals can still feel meaningful. Natural soap makes a beautiful small gift — personal, useful, and easy to pair with a towel, bath brush, candle, or handwritten note.

 

Bandana with charms from La Maison Angelique

A small fashion piece with personality

For something with a little more personality, the bandana with charms from La Maison Angelique adds a stylish and playful touch. It can be worn, tied to a bag, styled as an accessory, or gifted as a small fashion piece with character. It feels light, expressive, and perfect for May’s softer, pre-summer mood.

These are gifts for people who appreciate detail — the scent, the texture, the story, the charm.

 

For the Desk That Needs a Fresh Start

Levo Leather Caddy from Casa Quesera

A refined practical piece that brings order and beauty to any workspace

May is also a beautiful moment to appreciate the people who keep things moving – colleagues, makers, business owners, or anyone whose daily work is built on quiet dedication.

With its refined leather finish and practical design, the Levo Leather Caddy from Casa Quesera brings a sense of order to a desk, workspace, or creative corner.

It’s a polished little reminder that their work matters, and the space they work in deserves something beautiful too.

 

For a Home Accent with Quiet Beauty

The marble base with glass tubes from Zoya Stone

A small, sculptural piece that brings character and quiet elegance to any space.

The marble base with glass tubes from Zoya Stone adds a sculptural, elegant detail to any space. Locally made and designed with natural materials, it feels like a small piece of art — perfect for fresh stems, dried flowers, or simply as a beautiful object on a table, desk, or shelf.

It is a thoughtful gift for someone who loves home pieces with character, craftsmanship, and a sense of place.

 

The May Mood Edit is a celebration of gifts proudly created in the UAE for the season before summer. Thoughtful, practical, and chosen with care – with many sustainable pieces that make the gesture feel even more meaningful.

title: GENTLE GIFTS FOR KIDS WHO NEED TO UNWIND
excerpt: A Softer Kind of Play Not every gift has to be loud to be loved. Some of the most thoughtful ones are the gifts that help children slow down, settle, and find comfort in quiet play. This is an edit rooted in calm creativity: tactile play, mindful activities, and small rituals that bring a softer … Read More about GENTLE GIFTS FOR KIDS WHO NEED TO UNWIND

content.rendered:
A Softer Kind of Play

Not every gift has to be loud to be loved. Some of the most thoughtful ones are the gifts that help children slow down, settle, and find comfort in quiet play.

This is an edit rooted in calm creativity: tactile play, mindful activities, and small rituals that bring a softer rhythm to the day.

From playdough and satisfying stretchy slime to candle making, growing a miniature magical garden, and guided journaling, each one offers children a beautiful way to engage their hands and minds while encouraging a sense of ease.

Ideal for birthdays, care packages, or just-because gifting, they offer something children need more of: a calm place to land.

In a world that often feels overstimulating, gentle play can be a gift in itself.

Yalla Together Edit

The Power of Play: Playdough Sensory Kit


Pizza Shop Play Kit – Power of Play

Soft, tactile, and endlessly open-ended, playdough is one of childhood’s timeless pleasures.

The non-toxic playdough from The Power of Play transforms simple sensory play into a beautifully absorbing experience, inviting children to roll, press, shape, and create at their own pace. It’s imaginative, calming, and full of quiet possibility.

Gooru: Slime


Spring Fest – Gooru Slime

For children who delight in texture-led play. Gooru Slime offers a wonderfully satisfying sensory experience. Glossy, stretchy, and impossible to resist.

It’s the kind of activity that captures attention instantly while giving kids a playful outlet for calm, hands-on exploration.

The Pausitive Box: Candle Making


Candle Making Kit for Kids – The Pausitive Box

For older children who enjoy thoughtful activity, the candle-making kit from the Pausitive Box brings a more elevated kind of creativity to playtime. There is something quietly special about making something from scratch, and this kit transforms an afternoon activity into a keepsake.

A lovely choice for kids who enjoy craft with a more mindful, made-by-me feel.

Eco Bonjour: Grow Your Own Mini Magical Garden


Grow Your Own Mini Magical Garden – Eco Bonjour

Part craft, part nature activity, part tiny enchanted world, the Grow Your Own Magical Garden from Eco Bonjour is full of charm. Eco-friendly and imaginative, it invites children to build, plant, and nurture something of their own.

It’s the kind of gift that feels both magical and grounding – a small world to care for and watch come to life.

The Scribe Journal: Guided Journal


Kids Journal – The Scribe Journal

The guided Journal from The Scribe Journal is a gentle invitation for children to pause, reflect, and express themselves. Whether they are writing, doodling, answering prompts, or capturing little thoughts from the day, it offers a calm and reassuring space of their own.

Why this Edit Feels Special

What makes these gifts so appealing is not only what they do, but how they feel. They encourage children to slow down, focus gently, and enjoy play that is immersive without being overwhelming. In their own different ways, each one creates room for imagination, comfort, and calm.

Sometimes the loveliest gifts are the ones that bring a little more softness to childhood.

For those drawn to gifts with a more thoughtful spirit, this edit is a beautiful place to begin.

content.rendered:
Gifts with Impact: A Map of Meaningful Gifting

In a world of endless options and next-day delivery, gifting can sometimes feel rushed. But every now and then, a gift comes along that feels different. It carries a story, a sense of place, and a human touch.

Our Gifts With Impact Map was created to help you rediscover the art of thoughtful gifting – one that celebrates craftsmanship, supports communities, and turns every present into something meaningful.

Why Locally Designed Matters

When you choose a locally designed gift, you are doing more than picking up something beautiful. You’re becoming part of a larger story.

You’re supporting small businesses and independent makers who pour time, skill, and passion into their work. You’re helping preserve traditions – whether it’s a pattern inspired by regional heritage or a beauty ritual passed down through generations. And in a quiet but powerful way, you are also making a more sustainable choice by reducing the journey your gift takes before it reaches your hands.

In a place as vibrant and diverse as the UAE, local creativity thrives in every corner – often hidden in small studios, homegrown brands, and emerging concepts waiting to be discovered.

Yalla Together’s Picks: Small Details, Big Meaning

Our interactive map brings together a thoughtful selection of locally created gifts, chosen not just for their beauty, but for the feeling they carry:

  • TWOfold:

Double-sided jacket from Twofold

Designed in small batches with care, these clothes carry the kind of charm that mass production doesn’t always captures.
Among the standout finds are double-sided jackets, offering two looks in one.
As a gift, it feels personal, stylish, and intentional.

  • By Dina Saadi: Wild Poppy Scarf

Wild Poppy Scarf by Dina Saadi

A versatile scarf like this makes a beautifully thoughtful gift, blending style with story.
Designed by the talented Syrian-Russian street artist Dina Saadi and inspired by the rich cultural heritage of the Levant, it can be worn as a headband, neck scarf, handbag twilly, or even a pet bandana.
It’s a small piece with many lives – elegant, expressive and full of character.
  • Saaf Skin:

Gold Dew Face Oil by Saaf Skin

Founded by two women-entrepreneurs, Saaf Skincare blends clean, sustainable beauty with the quiet luxury of Hojari frankincense resin from Salalah.
Rooted in regional heritage, it’s the kind of gift that feels thoughtful, nurturing, and deeply atmospheric.
  • MC&Co: The Date Drop

 

The Date Drop by MC&Co

MC&Co’s The Date Drop turns organic date syrup into a gift with both beauty and purpose.
Housed in a sculptural bottle shaped like a single falling drop, it feels thoughtful, design-led, and deeply rooted in the region.
Supporting local date farmers and regional food craftsmanship, it’s a lovely way to gift something that honors both everyday ritual and local heritage.
  • Rocknshine.me: Beauty Case

 

Beauty Case by Rock and Shine

This beauty case from Rock and Shine makes a gift with beauty beyond the surface.
Thoughtfully made by refugee artisans, it carries a deeper sense of purpose. Supporting community, craftsmanship, and meaningful likelihoods.
Both practical and polished, it’s the kind of gift that feels stylish, useful, and quietly impactful.
  • Creavivo: Prism Loop

Prism Loop Earrings by Creavivo

Handmade from polymer clay, designed and made in the UAE. Creavivo’s Prism Loop earrings are a stylish gift for someone who loves modern pieces with an artistic edge.
They’re also a lovely way to support a homegrown business through something beautifully made.

A More Thoughtful Way to Gift

Whether you’re celebrating Mother’s day, marking a special occasion, or simply showing appreciation, choosing brands with meaning and purpose, adds a layer of intention that can’t be replicated.
It’s a way of saying: This was chosen with care.
The next time you give a gift, share its story and tell them about the hands that created it. Because often, it’s not just the object that stays with us – it’s the meaning behind it.
And in a time where meaningful connections matter more than ever, that might just be the most valuable gift of all.

Ramadan Gift Ideas for Kids

Little Crescent Joys: Thoughtful Ramadan Gift Ideas For Kids

As the holy month of Ramadan draws near, it’s not only a time of reflection and togetherness, but also a special opportunity to create lasting memories with the little ones in our lives.

For children, Ramadan is filled with wonder, from moon sightings and suhoor wake-ups to the excitement of family gatherings and the joy of Eid preparations.

This year, why not celebrating their growing understanding of the season with meaningful gifts that nurture spirit, imagination, and joy?

Our curated Ramadan gift picks for kids combine playful learning with cultural appreciation, perfect for Iftar surprises, Ramadan advents, or Eid day delights.

Ramadan Storybook

Zingo Ringo Books: Hassan & His 30 Good Deeds

Stories that spark good deeds: a meaningful Ramadan read for kids.

An inspiring Ramadan read for little hearts. Make the spirit of giving and kindness come alive this Ramadan with Hassan and His 30 Good Deeds, a heartwarming children’s book designed to gently teach young readers the values of compassion, gratitude, and daily good actions during the holy month.
Perfect for bedtime reading or family storytelling, this beautifully illustrated book is more than just a story, it’s a guide to building character and nurturing faith in children.

How to gift it? Add a handwritten note inside the cover: “For your Ramadan library. Read this every year and tell me your favorite part.”

The Ramadan Countdown Calendar They Will Actually Use

Moonkie: Ramadan Countdown Calendar

A little countdown, a lot of good deeds. One card a day throughout Ramadan.

Countdowns create anticipation, and anticipation is half the joy. This Ramadan Calendar from Moonkie gives children something to look forward to each day. Thoughtfully designed with 30 soft, numbered pockets, this charming keepsake invites kids to discover a small surprise or deed each day, turning anticipation into a meaningful journey. Crafted with neutral, calming tones and made from child-safe materials, it’s as beautiful as it is engaging. A lovely gift to teach the spirit of giving and reflection.

Yalla Together tip: make it about identity not performance. Add a handwritten note such as: “You are someone who does good.”

Prayer Time Essentials, Made Kid-Friendly

Maison Tini: Salah Star Kit

Salah Star kit designed to encourage daily prayers.

Spark a love for prayer with the Salah Star Kit by Maison Tini, an inspiring Ramadan gift for little ones. This beautifully curated set includes a soft prayer mat that can be personalized with the child’s name, turning each prayer into a moment of pride and joy. Paired with a prayer tracker to inspire consistency and connection throughout the holy month. Whether gifted on the first night of Ramadan or tucked into an Eid surprise basket, this kit makes a meaningful and memorable present, one that support spiritual growth while celebrating the joy of Ramadan.

Celebrate Every Kind of Love: Valentine’s Gifts for Friends, Family, & Yourself

Valentine’s Day has always been seen through the lens of romantic love, but what about the other loves in our lives? Love is a journey, not a destination, and this Valentine’s Day, we are celebrating the many stops along the way.

This guide is dedicated to celebrating all kinds of love, from the friendships that bring us joy to the family bonds that keep us strong, and even the self-love that helps us thrive.

Let us redefine what it means to give love.

For the Friends Who Feel Like Soulmates:

They have seen you at your best and worst, and somehow still answer your texts within seconds. Show them how much they matter with gifts that celebrate your shared history.

Artist Tanya Hayek: Personalized Watercolor Portrait

A custom watercolor portrait that captures your bond in art.

A personalized watercolor portrait is a heartfelt and unique way to show your best friends how much they mean to you. Whether it’s a painting of the two of you together, their beloved pet, or a memory you share, this gift turns a moment into a piece of art they can cherish forever. Upload your favorite photo and the talented artist Tanya Hayek will transform it into a beautiful illustration, made with love.

Night Blossom Beads: Personalized Natural Stone Bracelet

A heartfelt touch – This personalized stone bracelet says it all.

For a meaningful and stylish Valentine’s Day gift for a friend, consider a personalized bracelet made from natural stones that hold unique energy, making this gift both beautiful and thoughtful. Add a custom initial, name or message to create a piece that’s truly theirs. It’s a wearable reminder of your friendship and a lovely way to show you care.

Unlocked Games: Cozy Night-In Card Game for Friends

Heartfelt chats and cozy vibes with these therapist-designed cards.

Perfect for a heartwarming Valentine’s Day gift, these cozy night-in game cards designed by a therapist, are made to spark meaningful conversations and deeper connection between friends. They are ideal for a relaxed evening and laughter flowing. Thoughtful, comforting, and connection driven, this deck turns any night in into quality time well spent. Include gourmet popcorn and cozy socks for a fun night in.

Yalla Together Tip: Add a handwritten note with a shared memory or inside joke for an extra heartfelt touch.

For the Family That’s Always There

Love that runs deep, it’s a perfect way to celebrate the people who make you feel loved, supported and seen.

Lumena Maison: The Secrets of the Emirati Dhow Silk Scarf

A timeless silk scarf with Emirati flair – for the woman who matter most.

This Valentine’s day, first, celebrate the grace and strength of the women in your life; your mother, sister, or mother-in-law with a timeless gift that carries the soul of Emirati heritage. For example, a silk scarf inspired by the traditional dhow, evokes stories of resilience, craftsmanship, and connection to the sea. Moreover, It’s more than an accessory, it’s a wearable piece of art for the women who deserve something truly meaningful.

Memento: Gift an Experience

Make memories this Valentine’s Day with a heartfelt family lunch or dinner experience.

This Valentine’s Day, celebrate the love that holds your family together with a meaningful experience, a special lunch or dinner out. It’s a heartfelt way to create lasting memories.

Pranamat: Pro Massage Set

A wellness gift of relaxation and self-care.

Show your love through the gift of relaxation and well-being this Valentine’s Day with the Pranamat Massage Set. Perfect for anyone in the family who deserves some pampering, this acupressure mat combines ancient therapy with modern design to ease stress, reduce muscle tension, and support better sleep. Ethically crafted, it’s a gift that says “I care” in every details. A beautiful way to encourage rest, recharge, and daily self-care.

Yalla Together note: These gifts go beyond objects, they are thank-yous wrapped in paper.

For Yourself, Because Why Not?

Baba’s Cave: Cleopatra Bathtea Therapy

A Cleopatra-inspired tea bath – the perfect gift of self-love.

Cleopatra Bathtea Therapy is a luxury spa experience steeped in the rich heritage of Arabic beauty and wellness. Infused with regional botanicals, this aromatic soak invites rest, renewal, and transforms an ordinary bath into a sensory escape.

Skilldeer: Learning a New Skill

Let curiosity be your valentine! Celebrate self-love this Valentine’s Day by investing in you. Gifting yourself the opportunity to learn a new skill, offers long-term joy, personal growth, and a refreshed sense of purpose. It’s a reminder that love isn’t just about romance, but also about nurturing your own passions and potential.

Ounass: RAY-BAN Meta Gen 2 Skyler Sunglasses:

A little self-love, but make it smart with Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 Skyler sunglasses.

Treat yourself this Valentine’s Day by indulging in style and smart tech. These sleek, cat-eye smart glasses blend timeless glamour with cutting-edge Meta AI technology. It’s perfect for capturing life’s best moments hands-free, streaming music, taking calls, or asking your AI assistant for help on the go.

Yalla Together moment: Self-love isn’t selfish, it’s a revolution. Start with yourself.

Furthermore, whether you are gifting your friends, your actual family, your chosen family or yourself, the most beautiful presents are the ones that come from a place of intention.

In fact, thoughtful, warm, and meaningful gifts reflect the people they are for.

Because love isn’t limited to romance, it’s found in every corner of our lives. Let’s celebrate it all.

This Valentine’s Day, celebrate the love that holds your family together with a meaningful experience, a special lunch or dinner out. It’s a heartfelt way to create lasting memories.

Pranamat: Pro Massage Set

A wellness gift of relaxation and self-care.

Show your love through the gift of relaxation and well-being this Valentine’s Day with the Pranamat Massage Set. Perfect for anyone in the family who deserves some pampering, this acupressure mat combines ancient therapy with modern design to ease stress, reduce muscle tension, and support better sleep. Ethically crafted, it’s a gift that says “I care” in every details. A beautiful way to encourage rest, recharge, and daily self-care.

For Yourself, Because Why Not?

Baba’s Cave: Cleopatra Bathtea Therapy

A Cleopatra-inspired tea bath – the perfect gift of self-love.

Cleopatra Bathtea Therapy is a luxury spa experience steeped in the rich heritage of Arabic beauty and wellness. Infused with regional botanicals, this aromatic soak invites rest, renewal, and transforms an ordinary bath into a sensory escape.

Skilldeer: Learning a New Skill

Let curiosity be your valentine! Celebrate self-love this Valentine’s Day by investing in you. Gifting yourself the opportunity to learn a new skill, offers long-term joy, personal growth, and a refreshed sense of purpose. It’s a reminder that love isn’t just about romance, but also about nurturing your own passions and potential.

Ounass: RAY-BAN Meta Gen 2 Skyler Sunglasses:

A little self-love, but make it smart with Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 Skyler sunglasses.

Treat yourself this Valentine’s Day by indulging in style and smart tech. These sleek, cat-eye smart glasses blend timeless glamour with cutting-edge Meta AI technology. It’s perfect for capturing life’s best moments hands-free, streaming music, taking calls, or asking your AI assistant for help on the go.

Yalla Together moment: Self-love isn’t selfish, it’s a revolution. Start with yourself.

Furthermore, whether you are gifting your friends, your actual family, your chosen family or yourself, the most beautiful presents are the ones that come from a place of intention.

In fact, thoughtful, warm, and meaningful gifts reflect the people they are for.

Because love isn’t limited to romance, it’s found in every corner of our lives. Let’s celebrate it all.

content.rendered:
Gifts To Fuel New Year’s Resolutions 2026

January is the moment people swap party hats for planners, and the best gifts for New Year’s resolutions are the ones that make new habits easier, more enjoyable, and more likely to stick.

This guide gives you thoughtful, budget-conscious, and splurge-worthy ideas across three popular resolution categories: fitness & wellbeing, mindfulness & mental health, and sleep.

Why gifts that support habits work?

People keep resolutions when the friction is low.: small tools, clear next steps, and encouragement help habits form. In addition to that, a gift that’s useful day-to-day communicates support without pressure.

This round-up gives thoughtful, practical gifts designed to help someone actually stick to their 2026 resolutions, not just start them.

1. Fitness: gifts that make moving easier and more consistent.

Sun & Sand Sports: Nike Weighted Jump Rope

Sleek and travel-ready, it’s the motivational nudge that helps turn a resolution into a routine. Fast cardio for small windows of time.

Amazon: Whatafit Resistance Bands Set

Kick off New Year’s resolutions with a resistance bands set. A compact, all-in-one fitness kit that makes home and on-the-go workouts effortless. Featuring multiple resistance levels and essential accessories, it’s perfect for exercisers who want full-body workout, flexibility and cardio training anywhere.

GYM SOX: 5AM Club Socks

Slip into a little daily motivation. These comfy, soft socks features a bold “5AM Club” script to remind the wearer every morning that greatness starts early. Perfect as a New Year’s resolution gift, pair them with Robin Sharma’s “The 5 AM Club” to give someone the habit-forming toolkit plus a wearable reminder to rise, focus, and win the day. A thoughtful, simple bundle for anyone committed to fresh starts.

Habit Market: BoostWell Vitamin Patches

Kickstart their New Year’s resolution with energizing vitamin patches. A wearable boost of essential vitamins to help sustain natural energy throughout the day, perfect for busy mornings or workouts. A thoughtful gift for anyone ready to power through 2026 with more focus and vitality.

Virgin Megastore: Fitbit Charge 6 Advanced Fitness Tracker

Help them stick to their goals with a sleek, comfortable tracker that makes healthy habits easy. It pairs advanced health sensors ( continuous heart-rate, sleep and SpO2), built-in GPS, guided workouts, and on-wrist notifications. A practical, motivating gift for anyone starting a fitness journey.

Virgin Megastore: WHOOP MG Life with 12-Month Membership Activity Tracker

Give the gift of smarter recovery and performance tracking: a discreet wrist wearable plus a year of WHOOP’s coaching platform that delivers 24/7 strain, sleep and recovery scores, personalized recommendations, and training guidance. Ideal for anyone serious about improving fitness, sleep and stress management; actionable insights that keep New Year’s goals on track.

2. Mindfulness and Mental Health: Gifts that encourage daily reset moments.

ELI & KAI: Handmade Leather Journals

Start the year with intention: gift a handmade leather journal. A durable and elegant place for goal lists, daily reflections, and habit tracking. A thoughtful, tactile reminder to keep New Year’s resolutions on track. Available in different sizes and colors.

Impression Flowers: Flower Artistic Planner

It’s always great to start the year in style with a planner featuring an elegant artwork cover. Perfect for planning resolutions with beauty and purpose.

Decathlon: Yoga & Meditation Zafu Round Cushion

Give the gift of calm with a yoga and meditation cushion designed to support posture, deepen practice, and make daily mindfulness comfortable. It’s the perfect resolution starter for anyone ready to breathe, stretch, and reset in 2026.

Sy’a Teas: Moringa rise tea subscription

Moringa Rise Tea, a mindful morning ritual for clarity and calm. Gift a tin of Moringa Rise plus a 12- month tea subscription; monthly curated blends delivered to their door for a year of present-moment practice and steady mental clarity. The perfect New Year’s resolution bundle to build calm, focus, and lasting habits.

Art Therapy Dubai: gift an experience

Experience the reset: this gift voucher invites a loved one to prioritize mental well-being with a workshop led by artists, no art experience required. It’s a thoughtful, creative way to reduce stress and start fresh.

3. Sleep: gifts that multiply energy and willpower.

Two Bees: Mulberry Silk Pillowcase

A pure, sustainably sourced Mulberry silk pillowcase; soft, gentle on skin and hair, and naturally temperature-regulating. The perfect New Year’s resolution gift for better sleep.

Glacé: Relief Cap

Glacé relief cap is a cozy cooling and heat cap designed to ease nighttime tension and support more restorative sleep. Lightweight and easy to use, perfect for anyone who needs to sleep better and stress less.

The Sleep Chapter: Knitted Weighted Blanket

Give the gift of calm this New Year with a hand-knit weighted blanket made from 100% organic cotton. Luxuriously soft, sustainably sourced and crafted stitch-by-stitch, it delivers gentle, grounding pressure to help improve sleep, reduce stress, and support your resolution to prioritize self-care. A beautiful, eco-friendly gift to start the year with comfort that’s as kind to the planet as it is to the body.

No matter the resolution, healthier habits or staying organized, a thoughtful gift can turn ambition into action. Choose items that match the recipient’s goals, lifestyle, and budget and pair practicality with encouragement to make the new year’s journey feel supported, not pressured.

Well-chosen presents often have the biggest impact: they show you believe in someone’s goals and give them a tangible first step.

Which idea will you pick to help someone start the year strong?

content.rendered:
Holiday Edition 2025: Tween/Teen Boys

The holidays are prime time for finding that perfect present that lights up a tween or teen boy’s face, but trends changing fast and interests ranging from gaming and gadgets to sports and science. Whether you are shopping for a curious tween discovering new hobbies or a teen with a clear style and big opinions, you will find thoughtful, age-appropriate ideas that match different personalities and budgets.

Flip through the lists with your recipient in mind and you will be able to find something that feels uniquely suited to them. Ready to discover gifts that surprise and delight? Let’s get inspired.

 

For Tween Boys

Noon.com: Lego Gear Bots

Give a gift that turns holiday excitement into hands-on learning. LEGO gear bots are perfect for the curious tween who loves to build, experiment, and show off something that moves. These sets combine classic LEGO creativity with clever gearing and mechanical design so kids can construct a lineup of little robots and machines that spin, crawl, and react; all while learning basic engineering principles.

 

Noor’s Hereos: Illustrated Book About Mohamed Salah

An illustrated children’s book about Mohamed Salah makes a thoughtful gift for a tween boy who loves football or needs a role model. An illustrated biography of Mohamed Salah blends sport, perseverance and positive values into compact, visually rich present. Pair the book with an art print for an added flourish.

 

Sun & Sand Sports: Nike LEGO Collection Basketball

A LEGO x Nike inspired indoor/outdoor basketball makes a thoughtful, playful, and practical holiday gift. It blends collectible appeal with real performance, encouraging active play, skill building and hours of fun; perfect for backyard pick-up games, school gyms, and weekend shoot-arounds.

 

Decathlon: Kids’ Archery Bow Discovery Junior

The moment the bow comes out of its wrapping and the first arrow finds the target; that discovery moment is holiday magic. For a tween boy, an archery bow can be more than a toy, it’s a gateway to a new skill, outdoor play, confidence, and focus. If you’re hunting for a holiday gift that’s active, memorable, and a little different; the kids’ archery bow deserves a spot on your gift list.

 

Virgin Megastore: Discovery Mindblown Magnetic Building Tiles With Remote Control

A brilliantly tactile STEM gift that combines magnetic architecture with remote-controlled motion. Perfect for tweens who like to build, tinker and race their creations.

 

Terribly Real: MINI UAE Verified Off-White Sweatshirt

Bring a touch of UAE to his wardrobe with this cozy, off-white sweatshirt. It’s a thoughtful, useful, and stylish holiday gift. It’s wearable everyday, and offer a gentle cultural connection.

 

Level Shoes: Eat My Socks Cheeseburger Socks

Eat My Socks hamburger socks are a tiny but memorable holiday gift: silly enough to make him smile, and practical enough for everyday wear. Great for tucking into a stocking and even better when teamed with a gift card to a nearby burger spot.

 

For Teen Boys

Virgin Megastore: HyperX Cloud Alpha Wireless Gaming Headset

If the teen on your list cares about both competitive edge and audio quality or simply wants a comfy headset for long sessions; the HyperX Cloud Alpha Wireless is a thoughtful, high-impact gift.

 

Carrefour: PlayStation Portal Remote Player For PlayStation 5

Give the teen gamer in your life the gift of freedom this holiday: the PlayStation Portal remote player for PS5 streams your console’s games to a portable screen and controller, so they can play anywhere in the house or on the go with a good connection. It’s a thoughtful present for a teen who loves console gaming but needs flexibility.

 

Raketi.co: Racket Set

A racket set is a fantastic pick for teens. Whether he is into tennis, badminton, pickleball, or just likes to be outdoors with friends, a well-chosen racket set combines play, fitness, and social time. It Definitely makes an impressive present.

 

Loud Mood: Party Waves Tee

Meet the “Party Waves” tee: a casual, cool T-shirt inspired by the rhythm and motion of ocean surf. It’s a simple, stylish, holiday gift that balances fashion, comfort and personality. Goes great alongside a tumbler and a set of themed stickers for a fully curated gift set.

 

The Giving Movement: Teens Oversized Zip Hoodie

Give the gift of cozy cool and conscious style this season with an oversized zip hoodie made from eco-friendly materials. The perfect pick for a teen who cares about comfort and the planet. Even better, a small portion of every purchase is donated to charity. Stylish, conscious and committed to community causes. Available in a variety of colors.

 

Sharaf DG: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Tablet – WiFi 16GB 7inch

If you want a practical, memorable gift, the Kindle Paperwhite is perfect. Not only focused on reading, but also durable, portable, and distraction-free for teens.

 

Virgin Megastore: Bose QuietComfort Headphones

Give him a gift that gets used every day: Bose QuietComfort headphones combine class-leading noise cancellation, comfy over-ear cushions, and clear sound for music and calls. They help block distraction for studying, make commutes and travel more enjoyable, and deliver reliable battery life and durable design he will appreciate long after the holidays.

 

Amazon: Apple AirTag 4 packs

Practical, techy, and built to disappear into a teen’s everyday gear; a 4-pack of Apple AirTag is a perfect holiday pick for a teen who’s always on the move. Tuck onto his tech and everyday items to stop the “where did I leave that?” scramble.

Wellness and Self-Care Diwali: Gifts The Glow From Within!

Diwali is a celebration of light, renewal and togetherness. It’s a perfect moment to give gifts that do more than sparkle. This year, instead of the usual boxes of sweets and glittering trinkets, consider gifting experiences and items that nourish the body, sooth the mind and encourage gentle self-care.

Wellness gifts are thoughtful, lasting reminders that you care about someone’s well-being long after the diyas have been extinguished.

In this guide you will find curated ideas, personalization tips and sustainable choices to help you craft heartfelt, health-forward gifts.

Read on to discover ways to make this Diwali not only bright, but deeply nourishing for the people you love.

 

Diffuser + Essential Oil Set from Curate Home: AED300

Diwali is a time for light, warmth, and fresh beginnings. A time when homes are decorated and filled with scents of festive foods, flowers and incense.
A well-chosen diffuser and essential oil set makes a thoughtful, modern Diwali present to capture that sensory warmth. It brightens the home, promotes calm and focus after festive bustle, and feels both luxurious, practical and long lasting.
Here is a guide to presenting and personalizing a diffuser and oil set that will delight family, friends, or colleagues this Diwali.
This set from Curate Home comes in a nice gift box so you don’t need to worry about the packaging and how to present it. However, if you wish to make this gift even more meaningful, you can consider adding a personal touch like:
  1. A handwritten note such as: “Wishing you a restorative and peaceful Diwali. Enjoy!”
  2. Add extra curated oils based on recipient’s taste:
    • Sandalwood: warm, grounding, traditionally used in Indian rituals and perfect for stressed loved ones.
    • Rose: Romantic, festive, uplifting and perfect for romantics.
    • Sweet orange or bergamot: Bright, cheerful and perfect for energetic friends.
  3. Include a short ritual card with suggested blends for meditation, hosting guests, or winding down after festivities.

 

Custom Candle from MJM Home Fragrance

A bespoke candle elegantly packaged and personalized is more than a decor. It is warmth, scent and thoughtfulness wrapped into a single gesture. It combines tradition (light, diya symbolism) with contemporary and sustainable luxury that can be tailored for every recipient. It’s a little light to carry throughout the year!
At MJM Home Fragrance, you have the option to create custom Diwali candle made from natural wax, wooden wicks and quality fragrance oils, it is tailored to your scent preferences, design, budget and personalized with your message.
Here are some suggested messages:
  1. Short and sweet: “Shine on. Happy Diwali!”
  2. For friends: “Let’s light up the night and make memories. Happy Diwali!”
  3. Romantic: “Shine bright today and always.”
  4. Spiritual: “Prayers for a blessed and prosperous Diwali for you and your family.”
  5. For Colleagues/Corporate: “May this Diwali brings new goals and great achievements.”
  6. Funny: “Good times guaranteed. Happy Diwali!”
To add extra charm, here are some curated pairings and gift ideas to complement your present:

Boo-tiful Treats: No-Candy Halloween Gifts Kids Will Scream For!

Halloween is the one night of the year when spooky fun and small surprises go hand in hand, but candy isn’t the only way to make October 31 feel special. Whether you are looking for healthier alternatives, avoiding sugar highs and crashes, or simply want to hand out something that will be kept instead of tossed, non-candy treats are the clever, considerate answer.

In this guide, you will find creative and age-appropriate alternatives for trick-or-treaters and keepsakes that kids will actually use. I have gathered ideas that are fun, safe, and memorable.

Read on to discover playful alternatives that make every “trick-or-treat” feel like a treat. No sugar required!

 

Build-A-Bear

Giving a Build-A-Bear for Halloween is a delightful, customizable gift that blends spooky fun with comforting play. It works well for a wide range of ages and can be tailored to be playful, mildly spooky, or super sweet depending on the child.

 

The birth certificate that comes with it and the customizations turn the plush into a memorable keepsake. This soft friend can be a costume body and soothes bedtime jitters after an exciting halloween night.

 

How to present the gift:
  1. Tuck the bear into a small pumpkin bucket so it looks ready for the night.
  2. Include the birth certificate and a nice storybook. You can check Virgin Megastore.ae for a wide variety of Halloween books for kids.
  3. Add a handwritten note such as: “Happy Halloween! Meet (Name of the bear) you new trick-or-treat buddy for more spooky fun and cozy cuddles!”.
A Build-A-Bear for Halloween blends excitement and comfort. With simple customization, it becomes both a fun Halloween companion and a lasting toy for the child to treasure. Check current seasonal collections and safety labels to match the child’s age and preferences.

 

Power of Play Grab & Go Halloween Playdough Jar from Strawberryfields.ae: AED 80

This Halloween, swap sugary treats for a playful, longer-lasting gift. A handmade, non-toxic and Halloween-themed playdough jar is a thoughtful and memorable treat that parents will actually appreciate and kids play with long after October 31.

 

Packaged with some Halloween flair, it blends creative play with seasonal charm. A little handmade magic that invites imagination and squishy fun.

Here are simple steps to make your gift a bundle and pick a name for it such as:
  1. Spooky Sculptor: Grab & Go playdough jar + cookie cutter (pumpkin, ghost, bat…) + googly eyes + tools set (roller pin, mat etc. available at The Power of Play) + mini craft book.
  2. Present in a small box filled with orange/black crinkle cut shredded papers or confetti and wrap it with a ribbon.
  3. Attach a card with a note like: “Happy Hauntings! Make spooky creations.”

 

BoxFetti Halloween Treasure Hunt Kit: AED 50

This Halloween I picked this treasure hunt kit for my 8 years old daughter. She has always loved clues, maps, and the thrill of discovery, so I wanted something that would turn Halloween evening into an interactive adventure rather than just trick-or-treat dash. Seeing her run from one clue to the next, decoding and squealing when she finds the next hiding spot, will definitely make the evening magical.

 

The kit delivered: Hooray! It’s easy to set up, perfectly themed, and full of small delights that keep kids engaged from the first clue to the final treasure.

 

Here are some tips for making the most of this treasure hunt kit:
  1. Pair the hunt with soft spooky music and some Halloween decoration so it feels seasonal but not frightening.
  2. Add personal touches along with the clues: slip in a handwritten note praising their detective skills, a favorite tiny toy, or a custom prize at the end to make it feel unique.
  3. Shorten or lengthen clues for your child’s age. For little kids, they might need a bit of help or give them some pictures clues.
  4. For group play: split kids into teams and have them race or collaborate.
This treasure hunt kit creates a memorable Halloween experience and I can confidently recommend it to other parents looking for a fun, low-stress holiday activity.
It’s a gift that keeps that whole family smiling!

The Sprouters Make Your Own Party Masks: AED 35

Make Your Own Party Masks Kit is a winner: it’s creative, hands on, and doubles as both an activity and a costume accessory. Ideal for little kids, these kits spark imagination and gives parents a contained, gift-ready craft that is easy to supervise.

 

My presentation and gifting ideas:
  1. Gift it as a kit: place the kit in a paper bag with ribbon and a handwritten note like: “Make your spooky mask!” 
  2. Pair with extras: glow-in-the-dark stickers, a small set of washable, non-toxic face paints for an instant costume bundle.
  3. Themed bundle: match the mask kit with a board book about Halloween and a small pumpkin plush.

 

Lush Haunted House Gift Box: AED 200

If you are looking for a playful, sensory-packed Halloween gift that turns bath time into a spooky but fun celebration, the Lush ”Haunted House” bath bombs gift box is a brilliant pick. It pairs theatrical fizz and color of bath bombs with Halloween-themed whimsy. It’s an ideal gift for kids and tweens who love a little drama and a lot of bubbles.

 

Create an experience: unboxing and after-bath!
  1. Turn the unboxing into an activity: have kids guess the scent or color before dropping the bath bomb in.
  2. After the bath: offer a cozy Halloween-themed towel, and a cup of warm milk or cacao to round out the experience.
Safety tips:
  1. Always read the ingredient list before buying, look out for potential allergens (for example: fragrance or substance sensitivity).
  2. Always supervise children in the bath. Bath bombs can make the tub slippery; keep a close eye on.
The Lush “Haunted House” bath bombs gift box is a thoughtful, imaginative Halloween present that transforms bath time into a little spooky celebration. With the right supervision and attention to ingredients, it’s a delightful way to make Halloween memorable for kids, colorful, fragrant and fun!

 

Mumzworld Cauldron Quest Board Game: AED 137

If you are haunting for a Halloween gift that’s fun, imaginative, and family-friendly, Cauldron Quest is a top pick. It’s a great alternative to sugary treats. An experience kids will remember and play again and again.

 

The box is box-ready, colorful artwork and fun components make it instantly presentable under the Halloween glow.

 

For an extra charm, consider:
  1. Pairing the gift with a themed toy to turn it into a bundle. A hit for kids thanks to the extra toy 😉

Virgin Megastore Wednesday Stationery Set: AED 89

A Wednesday inspired stationery set with its moody and playful aesthetic hits the sweet spot between Halloween-appropriate and everyday-useful. It’s ideal for kids who love drawing, writing, crafting or playing make-believe.

 

This set includes the following items: 1 pencil case, 1 notebook, 1 pen, 1 eraser and 1 ruler.

 

How to present it:
  1. This set can be presented in a black kraft box with black/purple shredded papers.
  2. Pair it with a vintage bookmark.
  3. Attach a personal note such as:“A little something for a wickedly clever writer. Happy Halloween!”.

 

Lego Book Nook Hogwarts Express: AED 449

A Lego Hogwarts Express book nook is a thoughtful, imaginative Halloween gift that becomes both a playset and a lasting room decoration. It’s perfect for kids/tweens (9 years old +) who love Harry Potter books, adore stories, staging scenes, and the magic of a train that disappears into another world.

 

Presentation ideas and pairing suggestions:
  1. Spooky unwrapping: wrap the box in a black or deep purple, tie twine, and a luggage tag-style keychain “Platform 9 3/4” or card.

  3. Tuck in a handwritten note: “May this little nook bring big adventures and cozy evenings. Keep it on your shelf and remember: magic is always near!”.

 

Top Chef Cooking Studio: Mini Vampire Chefs AED 250

Give the gift of hands-on creativity this Halloween: a kids’ cooking class that blends seasonal flavors, spooky fun, and kitchen skills. Perfect for children aged 5 to 12, this experience turns trick-or-treat night into a chance to learn taste,  and take home tasty treats.

 

The class will be on Friday October 31, 2025 from 3:00 pm to 5:30 pm. It includes a Halloween themed menu:
  • Chicken Fingers, Witch’s Cauldron Gnocchi, Bloody Sauce

Halloween is the one night of the year when spooky fun and small surprises go hand in hand, but candy isn’t the only way to make October 31 feel special. In this guide, you will find creative and age-appropriate alternatives for trick-or-treaters and keepsakes that kids will actually use. I have gathered ideas that are fun, safe, and memorable.

Read on to discover playful alternatives that make every “trick-or-treat” feel like a treat. No sugar required!

 

Build-A-Bear

Giving a Build-A-Bear for Halloween is a delightful, customizable gift that blends spooky fun with comforting play. It works well for a wide range of ages and can be tailored to be playful, mildly spooky, or super sweet depending on the child.

 

The birth certificate that comes with it and the customizations turn the plush into a memorable keepsake. This soft friend can be a costume body and soothes bedtime jitters after an exciting halloween night.

 

How to present the gift:
  1. Tuck the bear into a small pumpkin bucket so it looks ready for the night.
  2. Include the birth certificate and a nice storybook. You can check Virgin Megastore.ae for a wide variety of Halloween books for kids.
  3. Add a handwritten note such as: “Happy Halloween! Meet (Name of the bear) you new trick-or-treat buddy for more spooky fun and cozy cuddles!”.
A Build-A-Bear for Halloween blends excitement and comfort. With simple customization, it becomes both a fun Halloween companion and a lasting toy for the child to treasure. Check current seasonal collections and safety labels to match the child’s age and preferences.

 

Power of Play Grab & Go Halloween Playdough Jar from Strawberryfields.ae: AED 80

This Halloween, swap sugary treats for a playful, longer-lasting gift. A handmade, non-toxic and Halloween-themed playdough jar is a thoughtful and memorable treat that parents will actually appreciate and kids play with long after October 31.

 

Packaged with some Halloween flair, it blends creative play with seasonal charm. A little handmade magic that invites imagination and squishy fun.

Here are simple steps to make your gift a bundle and pick a name for it such as:
  1. Spooky Sculptor: Grab & Go playdough jar + cookie cutter (pumpkin, ghost, bat…) + googly eyes + tools set (roller pin, mat etc. available at The Power of Play) + mini craft book.
