The kit delivered: Hooray! It’s easy to set up, perfectly themed, and full of small delights that keep kids engaged from the first clue to the final treasure.

 

Here are some tips for making the most of this treasure hunt kit:
  1. Pair the hunt with soft spooky music and some Halloween decoration so it feels seasonal but not frightening.
  2. Add personal touches along with the clues: slip in a handwritten note praising their detective skills, a favorite tiny toy, or a custom prize at the end to make it feel unique.
  3. Shorten or lengthen clues for your child’s age. For little kids, they might need a bit of help or give them some pictures clues.
  4. For group play: split kids into teams and have them race or collaborate.
This treasure hunt kit creates a memorable Halloween experience and I can confidently recommend it to other parents looking for a fun, low-stress holiday activity.
It’s a gift that keeps that whole family smiling!

The Sprouters Make Your Own Party Masks: AED 35

  2. Pair with extras: glow-in-the-dark stickers, a small set of washable, non-toxic face paints for an instant costume bundle.
  3. Themed bundle: match the mask kit with a board book about Halloween and a small pumpkin plush.

  2. After the bath: offer a cozy Halloween-themed towel, and a cup of warm milk or cacao to round out the experience.

Holiday Edition 2025: Kids

The holidays are a magical time for kids and adults. A season of wonder, surprises, and joy. As such, it’s the perfect moment to give gifts that spark imagination, build skills, and create lasting memories.

This guide features everything from classic toys and STEM kits to arts-and-crafts sets, books, and active-play items. Here’s to big smiles under the tree!

Virgin Megastore: Osmo Little Genius Starter Kit

The Osmo Little Genius Starter Kit is a top pick for kids ages 3–5, combining hands-on play with interactive apps to build early literacy, vocabulary, fine motor skills, and creativity. It’s perfect for families with a compatible tablet who want quality screen time that still supports real-world learning.

Amazon.ae: Easel Artist Set

An easel artist set is more than a toy, it’s an invitation to explore, experiment, and express; it gives kids a dedicated space to create and a present that keeps giving long after the wrapping paper is gone.

 

Decathlon: Gymnastic Tumbling Mat

A gymnastic tumbling mat is a practical holiday gift that not only promotes active play but also builds strength and confidence. Whether a child loves gymnastics, cheer, martial arts, or simply flipping at home, this folding mat provides a safe and fun way to improve coordination and develop new skills.

Bebimine: 2-in-1 Storage Bean Bag

Looking for a holiday gift that’s fun, practical, and space-saving? A 2-in-1 storage bean bag offers cozy seating and built-in storage, keeping playrooms tidy. Plus, add favorite books for a “cozy corner” that sparks reading and imagination

Mumzworld: SmartMax Starter Set Pack of 23

A magnetic construction toy for young children that sparks STEM learning, creativity, and open-ended, hands-on play.

Amazon.ae: Nex Playground Indoor Play System

Give the gift of active, imaginative play this holiday season with Nex indoor playground system; a space-smart play solution that turns a living room into a safe, year-round play zone. Not only can multiple kids play together, but adults can join in as well, making it a perfect way to enjoy quality family time.

My Little Thieves: VTech KidiZoom Print Camera

Give the gift of instant memories with the VTech Kidi Zoom Camera—a playful, kid-friendly instant-print camera that lets kids snap, edit, and print their own photos, perfect for holiday fun and keepsake crafts

My Little Thieves: Personalized Name Piggy Bank Box

A personalized name piggy bank box is a thoughtful, functional, and customizable holiday gift that delights kids while teaching a lifelong skills.

MkandM: Geoboard

Give the gift of hands-on discovery; a geoboard combines art, math, and play into a timeless holiday present, perfect for curious kids and fun for a wide range of ages.

Dr. Feelings: My Feelings Puzzle

 

Help little learners name, share, and understand emotions with My Feelings Puzzle—a colorful, durable set that makes emotional learning playful. Moreover, it boosts vocabulary, empathy, and conversation skills in just minutes of daily play.

Power of Play: Medium Sensory Kit Natures Garden

Consider a holiday gift that cultivates creativity and calm: the Garden-inspired Sensory Kit. Made of all natural play dough, this kit provides a safe, multi-sensory experience tailored to young children.

 

Amazon.ae: Bee-Bot Programmable Floor Robot

Surprise curious kids with Bee-Bot this holiday: friendly programmable floor robot for screen-free coding, hands-on STEM, imaginative, durable and cooperative play.

 

Silly Little Goose: Mermaid/Pirate Wooden Peg Doll

Small, sturdy, and eco-friendly peg dolls make delightful stocking stuffers. A thoughtful, durable present that sparks creativity and last beyond the season.

 

BoxFetti: Miss Nella Glamorous Picks Special Edition

Give the gift of sparkle with Miss Nella’s Glamorous Gift Set. Not only safe and non-toxic, but also perfect for girls who love dress-up and beauty play.

 

Elli Junior: WAY TO PLAY King of The Road Car Edition

Surprise your little builder with the Waytoplay Road Car Edition—flexible road pieces for creating endless tracks and towns, perfect for imaginative, screen-free play.

An easel artist set is more than a toy, it’s an invitation to explore, experiment, and express; it gives kids a dedicated space to create and a present that keeps giving long after the wrapping paper is gone.

 

Decathlon: Gymnastic Tumbling Mat

A gymnastic tumbling mat is a practical holiday gift that not only promotes active play but also builds strength and confidence. Whether a child loves gymnastics, cheer, martial arts, or simply flipping at home, this folding mat provides a safe and fun way to improve coordination and develop new skills.

Bebimine: 2-in-1 Storage Bean Bag

Looking for a holiday gift that’s fun, practical, and space-saving? A 2-in-1 storage bean bag offers cozy seating and built-in storage, keeping playrooms tidy. Plus, add favorite books for a “cozy corner” that sparks reading and imagination

Mumzworld: SmartMax Starter Set Pack of 23

A magnetic construction toy for young children that sparks STEM learning, creativity, and open-ended, hands-on play.

Amazon.ae: Nex Playground Indoor Play System

Give the gift of active, imaginative play this holiday season with Nex indoor playground system; a space-smart play solution that turns a living room into a safe, year-round play zone. Not only can multiple kids play together, but adults can join in as well, making it a perfect way to enjoy quality family time.

My Little Thieves: Personalized Name Piggy Bank Box

MkandM: Geoboard

Give the gift of hands-on discovery; a geoboard combines art, math, and play into a timeless holiday present, perfect for curious kids and fun for a wide range of ages.

Dr. Feelings: My Feelings Puzzle

 

Help little learners name, share, and understand emotions with My Feelings Puzzle—a colorful, durable set that makes emotional learning playful. Moreover, it boosts vocabulary, empathy, and conversation skills in just minutes of daily play.

Amazon.ae: Bee-Bot Programmable Floor Robot

Surprise curious kids with Bee-Bot this holiday: friendly programmable floor robot for screen-free coding, hands-on STEM, imaginative, durable and cooperative play.

Small, sturdy, and eco-friendly peg dolls make delightful stocking stuffers. A thoughtful, durable present that sparks creativity and last beyond the season.

 

BoxFetti: Miss Nella Glamorous Picks Special Edition

Give the gift of sparkle with Miss Nella’s Glamorous Gift Set. Not only safe and non-toxic, but also perfect for girls who love dress-up and beauty play.

Surprise your little builder with the Waytoplay Road Car Edition—flexible road pieces for creating endless tracks and towns, perfect for imaginative, screen-free play.

Holiday Edition 2025: Tween/Teen Girls

The holidays are a magical time but if you are shopping for a teen or tween girl, it can also feel like navigating a constantly changing landscape of trends, tastes, and “do they even like this?” moments. Whether you are buying for a style savvy 14-year-old, a crafty 10-year-old, or the teen who lives for tech and playlists., the best gifts combine fun, function, and a little bit of personality.

Ready to make her face light up?

 

FOR TWEEN GIRLS:

Amazon.ae: Fahlo Bracelet

It’s more than an accessory, it’s a kid friendly way to spark curiosity about wildlife and conservation while giving her something she will actually wear. When you scan the token, you unlock the animal’s profile, photos, and ongoing updates; so the bracelet becomes a personal connection to a living creature in the wild or in a sanctuary.

 

Level Shoes: 4KIX Shoe Charm, Set of 3

Give her a little sparkle this season with a set of shoe charms; the tiny, joyful accents that instantly personalize her favorite pair. Perfect as a stocking stuffer or a thoughtful add-on to her new shoes. Shoe charms are playful and wonderfully versatile.

 

Tots Mine Jewelry: Perla’s Gold Magic Wand Necklace

Give her a little everyday magic with a delicate gold wand necklace. Perfect for tweens who love sparkle and stories. It’s a whimsical keepsake that grows with her style.

 

Virgin Megastore: Garmin Vivofit Jr 3 Disney Princess Fitness Tracker

It’s an adorable, durable activity tracker that turns daily steps into fun. With a kid-sized adjustable band featuring beloved Disney designs, long lasting battery, water resistant for swim-friendly wear, and a parent-controlled app full of challenges, reminders and reward-based chores. It’s a thoughtful way to encourage healthy habits and the active tween who loves adventures.

 

Sharaf DG: Fujifilm INSTAX MINI 12 Instant Film Camera

It’s a fun, easy-to-use instant camera that turns everyday moments into a credit-card-sized photos she can hang on her wall or swap with friends. Lightweight, colorful, and it encourages creativity with instant keepsakes she can decorate with stickers and albums. Pair it with a mini photo album for a complete, giftable set that will spark smiles all season long.

 

Farfetch: Polo Ralph Lauren Robe

Wrap her in cozy holiday cheer with a Polo Ralph Lauren robe; a soft, plush pink that feels like a warm hug after chilly morning or post-bath pampering. This robe makes a memorable present she will reach for again and again. Pair it with bath bombs or a small journal to encourage quiet, creative downtime.

 

Virgin Megastore: 3Doodler Pen Start Essential Pen Set

It’s a fun, screen-free gift that turns tween’s doodles into real, hold-in-your-hand creations. Designed for younger makers, the low-heat, kid-safe pen uses eco-friendly plastic strands and a rechargeable battery so kids can build jewelry, mini sculptures, and  custom decorations right of the box.

 

Gooru Slime: Christmas Collection Slime

Spark holiday joy with a high-quality, non toxic slime; an ideal gift for tweens who love hands-on, sensory fun.

 

FOR TEENAGE GIRLS:

Brushifi: Dry Shampoo kit

Treat the teen in your life to a practical, non-toxic dry shampoo kit; ideal for busy school mornings or sports days. Include dry shampoo bottle, bamboo comb, and a pvc travel pouch. Pair it with a cute hair clip for an extra pop.

 

Sephora: The Miss Dior Beauty Ritual

Surprise her with Sephora’s Miss Dior beauty ritual: a pretty holiday set pairing the bright, youthful Miss Dior floral fragrance with Dior Addict Lip Glow and Backstage Rosy Glow Blush. The set is presented in iconic Dior gift-ready pouch drawing on couture elegance.

 

Carrefour: Beats studio Pro Wireless Bluetooth Headphones

The stylish gift that actually gets used. Plush and foldable cups make these wireless Bluetooth headphones a fashion-forward accessory, while active noise cancellation, transparency mode and long battery life deliver great sound for music, study or gym sessions. Perfect for a teen who loves tech and trends.

 

Level Shoes: Missoma Sculptural Pebble Pendant Necklace Set

Simple, sweet and totally on-trend; a pebble pendant necklace is the perfect holiday gift for a teen girl. Easy to layer, it’s a little keepsake she will reach for every day.

 

Le Pom Pom: Crossbody phone straps with case

Brighten her holidays with a gift that’s equal parts stylish and practical. A colorful crossbody phone straps with case. Perfect for the teen who’s always on the go, this hands-free phone holder keeps her device safe, accessible, and selfie-ready

 

Ground: The Giardino Flow Set

Holiday-Ready wellness kit; the perfect pick for the active teen who loves style and self-care. The set includes a pretty, non-slip yoga mat with a cozy grip socks and a silky scrunchie. A gift that’s as practical as it’s cute.

 

7matcha.co: DIY Matcha Essentials Set

Spark creativity and calm with this DIY Match Set: a cozy kit that includes a blank white ceramic bowl to paint, bamboo whisk and scoop, whisk holder and matcha sifter. It’s a gift that turns a soothing tea ritual into a holiday keepsake.

 

Ounass: Dyson Airwrap i.d.™multi styler and dryer – Straight + Wavy

Treat the teen on your list to a salon-level styling experience with the Dyson Airwrap™ multi-styler and dryer. This all-in-one tool is sleek, easy to use, and unmistakably luxe; makes a memorable splurge for a style-savvy teen.

Thoughtful Presents That Won’t Break the Bank!

Affordable thoughtful gifts don’t have to feel like a financial headache to find. Whether you are shopping for birthdays, holidays, or those small “just because” moments, affordable thoughtful gifts and meaningful gifts on a budget can be creative, memorable, and special.

This blog is your go-to resource for thoughtful gifts on a budget and budget-friendly gift ideas that show you care without the sticker shock. From affordable gift ideas to heartfelt surprises, you’ll discover that great gifting doesn’t have to cost a fortune.

Read on to explore affordable thoughtful presents that prove great gifting isn’t about how much you spend — it’s about the thought behind it.

Ready to find budget-friendly gifts and make someone’s day without emptying your wallet? Let’s get started.

Dash Mini Waffle Maker from Virgin Megastore: AED 89

A small kitchen gift that brings big morning joy. Perfect waffles, anytime!

 

A mini waffle maker is a small gift that delivers big smiles. It’s practical, affordable and instantly elevates ordinary mornings into something special.
Perfect for secret Santa, college students, couples or new parents who enjoy quick breakfast, apartment or tiny-home residents with limited kitchen space or foodies who enjoy experimenting with creative waffles.
Below are some presentations and pairing ideas if you like to make this thoughtful and fun gift feel luxe:
  1. Pair it with a small jar of gourmet pancake/waffle mix.
  2. Add a set of mini toppings: tiny jars of maple syrup, chocolate chips or nuts.
  3. Download this link for a quick bonus recipe to include in the gift.
  4. Package in a decorative box or basket with a ribbon and tuck in a small spatula inside.

 

Catchall Tray from Silsal Design House: AED 74

A simple, elegant way to keep life’s little essentials in one beautiful place

 

This catchall tray is one of those simple gifts that always feels thoughtful. It’s decorative, practical, and works for almost anyone; roommates, new homeowners, grads, parents or coworkers.
Presentation and pairing ideas:
  1. You can pair it with a nice candle, keychain or a pretty pen.
  2. Wrap in kraft paper with twine and tuck a sprig of dried lavender for an elevated look.
  3. Include a small card and a handwritten note like: “Because life’s little things deserve a cozy spot.“

Sandalwood Stupa Incense Sticks from Maison Etherique: AED 57

Warm sandalwood incense to bring calm, comfort, and a touch of everyday luxury

 

These sandalwood incense sticks that are handcrafted and ethically sourced make a lovely, budget-friendly gift that feels both personal and luxurious.
Their warm, woody aroma is calming and widely appreciated, making them a safe choice for many recipients and occasions like birthdays, holidays, housewarmings, bridal shower and corporate swag.
To make this gift even more memorable, you can pair it with many options:
  1. Meditation kit: Incense sticks + mini candle + guided meditation link.
  2. Relaxation kit: Incense sticks + herbal tea + eye mask.
  3. Spa at home: Incense sticks + small soap + bath salt sample.


Ivolador Plant Propagation Vase from Amazon.ae: AED 72

A beautiful way to grow new life

 

A plant propagation vase is a thoughtful and affordable gift that combines decor, education, and a slow-booming surprise. It’s small in price but big on charm, and it keeps giving every time a cutting turns into a new plant.
Who will love it ?
Definitely plant lovers, new plant parents, busy friends, moms, coworkers, students, and anyone who enjoys small, decorative items.
How to present it ?

Place the vase in a small gift box filled with shredded paper, wrap the box with a ribbon and include a printed plant-themed note. Check this one.

Wax Sachet Trio from Lila with Love: AED 75

Wax sachet adding a soft, elegant scent to your wardrobe

Lila with Love wax sachet trio is a thoughtful low-budget gift that still feels special.
Delicately scented and beautifully made, these wax sachets add a soft fragrance to drawers, wardrobes, or small corners of the home. It’s the kind of little gift that brings everyday charm without asking for much, making it a lovely choice for affordable gifting with a refined touch.
It’s ideal for:
  • A hostess as a small thank-you gift.
  • A friend who loves home details and enjoys soft scents.
  • A teacher as a modest thoughtful gesture.
  • A colleague for simple, safe gifting.
  • Anyone moving into a new home.
Here are my suggestions to present them as a gift:
  1. You can pair it with a handmade soap or small hand cream as a self-care set.
  2. To make it feel even more special, gift wrap can be added for just 3 AED.
  3. Add a care card and a short message.
Here are some short sample gift messages. Pick one that fits the recipient:
  • “A little gift with love.”
  • “A small gift to make you smile.”
  • “Wishing you comfort and joy.”
  • “A simple gift, chosen with care.”
  • “For your home, with love.”

It’s a very meaningful gift for nearly anyone, easy to personalize, simple to wrap, and sure to be used and appreciated long after the moment of unwrapping.

The Almond Delight Hand and Body Treat from L’Occitane: AED 60

A luxurious little self-care set—beautifully scented, travel-ready, and perfect for thoughtful gifting

 

This gift set hits the sweet spot for gifting, it looks luxe, smells delightful, and is genuinely useful, all without a premium price tag.
It’s a compact and travel-friendly present, the set includes 35ml almond shower oil, 15ml almond supple skin oil, 10ml almond hand and nail cream. All small sizes fit into a purse or suitcase, making them ideal for busy people who travel or commute.
The package is elegant and gift-ready. With the brand’s classic and clean design, you can simply:
  1. Tie a satin ribbon around the box and add a short card. A handwritten note like:”After a long day” or “For weekend self-care” to connect the gift to an experience.
  2. Pair the Almond Treat with a travel size hand sanitizer and/or a lip balm.
  3. Or tuck it into a small organza bag, a mini chocolate bar and a tea bag.

With a few inexpensive touches like ribbon, handwritten tag or a tiny extra, it becomes a memorable, budget-friendly gift that reads like a splurge.

Kikkerland Bedside Pocket from Amazon.ae: AED 64

Everything you need, right by your bedside.

 

A bedside pocket is an inexpensive, flexible gift that improves daily life in a small but meaningful way. It suits almost anyone, it’s great for readers, new parents (baby monitors/soothers/burp cloths), students in dorms, dwellers in tiny apartments, and travelers staying in airbnbs.
This gift can be personalized affordably and presented beautifully when filled with a few small extras. Below are some presentation and pairing ideas:
  1. Gift it pre-filled: add a tiny notepad, nice pen, sleep mask, hand cream or lip balm.
  2. For students: tuck in a compact charging cable, earbuds and sticky notes.
  3. For new parents: pair with swaddles, baby socks, or a pack of baby wipes.

To create a compelling presentation, tie it with twine and add a handwritten tag that says something like: “For everything you reach for at night.”

Thoughtful gifting doesn’t require a big budget. With creativity, personalization, and smart shopping, affordable thoughtful gifts can stand out just as much as expensive presents.

Use these budget-friendly gift ideas as a starting point. Adapt them to the recipient, and remember that the best affordable gift ideas are the ones that show you care — not the ones that cost the most.

Try one of these wallet-friendly gifts and share which budget-friendly idea was a hit!

content.rendered:
Holiday Edition 2025: Gifts for Her

The festive season is just around the corner ! It’s the perfect time to show the special women in your life how much you appreciate them but finding the right gift can be overwhelming. Whether you are shopping for a partner, mom, sister, friend or colleague, the best presents combine thoughtfulness with a touch of surprise.

This guide will help you move beyond the usual clichés and pick something she will truly love and remember.

Inside you will find a hand-picked mix of holiday gift ideas for her across styles and budgets: meaningful keepsakes, self-care treats, clever tech, wearable style, experience-based gifts, sustainable picks, and last minute saviors to make holiday shopping less stressful and more joyful.

Scroll on to discover fresh and crowd-pleasing options that will help you give with confidence and make her holidays sparkle this season.

Farfetch – Earrings From Heaven Mayhem

Give her the timeless symbol of connection with Heaven Mayhem’s Double Knot Earrings. Sleek, intertwined knots offer effortless everyday elegance.

Mezura – Handmade Embroidered Backless Vest

A delicate, artful piece that flatters every silhouette. Lightweight, versatile, and made with love. Gift ready and utterly unforgettable.

Pricklypear.me – The Girls Night in: A personalized Gift Box

Delight her and her crew with a cozy, customizable gift box for an unforgettable night at home. It includes: 40 Oz Hydrator, Oud Candle, Cozy Socks, Chatterbox Friends Edition.

Pamukme.com – Cotton Sofa Blanket/Throw

Cozy Reindeer-Patterned Throw, the perfect holiday gift for her. Soft, festive, and instantly charming, this throw adds seasonal warmth to sofas and beds while doubling as a style statement for cold nights and slow mornings.

Level Shoes – JW PEI Thea top handle bag

This affordable, fashion-forward piece is a stylish and thoughtful present for the woman who loves minimal chic.

Ounass.ae – JOVS 4D Laser Mask

Bring luxe at home with this high-tech device. It’s a standout holiday gift for the skin-care obsessed.

Bloomingdales.ae – Rituals Wreath Advent Calendar

Rituals Wreath Advent Calendar is a chic wreath-shaped countdown of daily mini pampering treats in festive scents. It’s an elegant, indulgent holiday gift for her who loves a daily moment of calm and luxury.

Loudmood.shop – Exist Loudly Cap

Give her the gift of bold self-expression with this chic cap embroidered “Exist Loudly”. A stylish, everyday reminder to own her voice. It’s the perfect accessory for the woman who isn’t afraid to be seen.

The Bloomspoon – Pillow Cover

A beautiful handmade pillow cover in soft, ethically sourced cotton crafted by Egyptian women artisans makes a thoughtful gift for sustainably minded woman. Stylish and eco-friendly, each purchase provides fair income and supports access to essential education and healthcare for the makers, so your gift brings comfort with real social impact.

Attachébyl.com – Cousteau Mini Terry Tote

Wrapped in soft terry cotton, this tote feels like a gentle hug. Ideal for beach days, gym sessions or weekend errands. It’s a thoughtful, practical gift she will reach for again and again.

Baileyjools.com – Waterproof Pouch Set

This set of 2 beautifully patterned pouches (small and large) keeps phone, sunscreen, jewelry and other belongings safe from sand, salt and spills, perfect for beach days or jetting off. It’s a thoughtful, everyday companion for her adventures.

alwaysunny.shop – Pilates Socks

Always Sunny socks features beautiful designs with non-slip soles perfect for pilates, yoga, barre, or cozy at home. they are a playful little pick-me-up that brightens her routine and keeps her moving in comfort.

Fehmeeda – Loungewear

Surprise her with this ultimate cozy-chic loungewear set made from 100% premium cotton. It balances comfort and polish. It’s an indulgent present that says relax and enjoy every time she wears it.

MOUNAY – The Fringe Top

An elegant, easy to wear fringe top/jacket that brings playful movement to any outfit. A lovely present for someone who loves elevated pieces that style effortlessly.

Musedubai.com – Frosted Petal Embroidered Handmade Abaya

This abaya is a wearable keepsake that celebrates her style and the care behind a truly handmade present.

Joyandco.com – The Joy Frame Set

This holiday, give her memories beautifully displayed with the Joy Frame Set. Pair it with a printed photo to make the sentiment truly unforgettable. It’s a timeless present for anyone who love sentimental, stylish décor.

Tanyahayek.com – Personalized Watercolor Portrait

It’s heartfelt, uniquely personal, and perfect for woman who cherishes meaningful gift. Turn a favorite moment into an artful memory she will treasure forever.

Dubai Opera Gift Voucher

Treat her to a night of magic with a Dubai Opera gift ticket, the perfect holiday surprise for anyone who loves culture, music and glamour. It’s a thoughtful, flexible gift that creates memories fay beyond any tangible present. Pair it with dinner for an extra-special touch.

Cece Jewelry – The Calm and Pearl Pendant

Cece Jewelry’s Clam & Pearl Pendant unfurls a tiny shell to reveal a single, moonlight pearl that seems to glow from within. It’s a timeless gift that says, without words, you are treasured.

content.rendered:
Holiday Edition 2025: Gifts For Him

Finding the perfect gift for the men in your life shouldn’t feel like a holiday scavenger hunt. Whether you’re shopping for a partner, dad, brother, friend, or co-worker, the best presents are the ones that show you’ve noticed what they love. From everyday comforts to big-tickets surprises.

In this guide, we have gathered curated ideas across styles, budgets, and personalities so you can give somethings he will actually use and love.

Scroll down to discover the perfect present for every kind of guy on your list, with quick tips to match gifts to personalities and price points. Let’s make holiday shopping simple, thoughtful, and joyful.

Butowels – Beach Towel

The Arabian Gulf-inspired beach towel blends story and substance: culturally rooted design, everyday utility and sustainable materials. It’s a stylish, thoughtful holiday gift for him that looks good, travels well and supports a greener wardrobe. You can pair with a mineral sunscreen, a stainless steel insulated tumbler or a printed travel guide to Dubai for inspiration.

Tropicfeel Store – Shelter Backpack

It’s a practical, polished, and adventure-ready. Perfect gift for the guy who does everything from quick weekend getaways to unexpected backcountry detours.

Socks Apart – Patterened Socks

Meet the perfect stocking stuffer gift for the guy who runs on caffein and bright ideas: a playful unmatched pair. Small, fun, and impossible not to smile at.

Room Envy – Bonjour Monsieur Mug

Charming and cheeky, the “Bonjour Monsieur” mug is a stylish nod to French flair. Perfect for the man who appreciates a touch of whimsy with his morning coffee. Ideal as a stocking stuffer or paired with a small-batch coffee beans, French butter biscuits or madeleines, or a set of coasters.

Inna Carton – Chess In The Cloud

Looking for a holiday gift that blends intellect, beauty, and a touch of wonder? A chess set inspired by the sky and clouds makes a memorable present for the man who appreciates design, strategy, and things that double as art. It’s more than a game, it’s a centerpiece that invites play and conversation.

O-derose.com – Salim Azzam Classic T-shirt – Endless Dreams

Surprise him this holiday with a gift that’s as personal as it is wearable: a soft cotton T-shirt hand-embroidered with the phrase meaning “Endless Dreams”. It’s thoughtfully stitched by hand, creating a subtle message that reads like a quiet promise. Perfect for the man who values meaningful details and understated elegance.

Silsal Design House – Leather Watch Box

The holidays are the time for thoughtful, lasting gifts. Something that says you appreciate his style, and you want to give him something useful that will last. A leather watch box checks all of those boxes. It’s a present that elevates his daily routine and protects pieces he cares about.

Bhalla Spices – Homemade Chilli Oil

A homemade chili oil made with olive oil is unexpectedly perfect holiday present for him. It’s flavorful, useful, and adds personality to any kitchen. From the home cook to the guy who thinks “extra” seasoning means a squeeze of hot sauce. Great paired it with a cookbook, add a handwritten note like: “To make every meal taste like a celebration!”

Montblanc – Iced Sea Bracelet In Soft Leather

The Montblanc Iced Sea bracelet is a refined choice that balances casual cool with luxury craftsmanship. Ideal for the man who appreciates understated accessories that make a statement.

Level Shoes – Boss Silk Tie

Give holiday style a polished upgrade with a Boss silk tie. It’s an elegant present that suits fathers, partners or colleagues who appreciate smart dressing.

Farfetch – The North Face Retro Denali Gilet

It’s a thoughtful, stylish and functional holiday gift for him especially if he likes outdoor-ready clothing with a retro edge. It’s versatile and durable to last through many winters, making it a gift that keeps on giving.

Virgin Megastore – Trezor Safe 3 Advanced Crypto Hardware Wallet

This holiday give a gift that protects what really matters. It’s practical, high-tech, and a little bit future-forward. Perfect for someone who is into crypto or just getting serious about digital assets.

Sharaf DG – Marshall Emberton III Bluetooth Speaker

If you’re searching for a holiday gift that looks as good as it sounds, the Marshall Emberton III Bluetooth speaker is a top contender. It blends Marshall’s iconic design with portable power. It’s the kind of gift that lands with a smile whether he is into music, podcasting, weekend barbecue or getaway.

Holiday Edition 2025: Babies and Toddlers

The Holidays are a magical time for little ones and for the grown-ups who loves to spoil them. Whether you’re shopping for a newborn’s first ever stocking, a curious crawler, or a busy toddler mastering new skills, this gift guide makes holiday shopping simple, joyful, and thoughtful.

We’ve rounded up toys, keepsakes, and practical must-haves that delight babies and toddlers while supporting early development, sensory exploration, and everyday family life.

Browse on for curated gift ideas that spark giggles, encourage learning, and create cherished holiday memories.

Amazon – Lovevery Developmental Activity

If you are shopping for a holiday gift that’s both beautiful and brain-boosting, the Lovevery play mat (play gym) is an excellent pick. It’s one of those presents that delights parents at unwrapping and keeps on giving through the first years of a child’s life.

Mumzworld – Baby Einstein Take Along Tunes

It’s a classic pick that’s effortless, affordable, and delightfully effective. Small, durable and built around music that soothes and stimulates, this little toy makes a great stocking stuffer or first-holiday present for infants and perfect for on-the-go entertainment.

Little Giggles – Musical Activity Table

The holidays are the perfect time to give a gift that’s fun, educational, and built to last. Bright, interactive and full of hands-on elements, this toy is a winner for little ones.

Mumzworld – SkipHop 3 Stage Activity Center

It’s a smart, practical, and fun pick. Designed to “grow with” little ones, it delivers years of developmentally appropriate play in one convertible piece, making it a high-value gift that caregivers appreciate.

Noon – Vtech First Steps Baby Walker

It’s an absolute favorite for parents and little ones. It combines interactive learning toys with supportive mobility, making it a thoughtful present for babies taking their first steps and curious toddlers.

Two Elephants – Little Gingerbread Man Crochet Plush Toy

A handmade gingerbread man plush toy is a charming, timeless holiday gift. Soft, squishy, and full of personality, this little cookie character is an adorable keepsake for young children that can make holiday memories for years to come.

Bebimine – Personalized Christmas Gift Set 4 Pieces in Wooden Box

A personalized baby Christmas gift set like this strikes the perfect balance between practical and precious: toys that soothe and stimulate, a keepsake romper that photographs beautifully, and handcrafted quality that makes the present memorable long after the holidays.

Littlechus – Christmas Stacking Train

A wooden Christmas stacking train is the perfect present for babies and toddlers. It’s festive, tactile, and encourages open-ended play; all wrapped up in a classic toy that lasts beyond the season.

Nohm Store – Christmas Long Sleeve Pyjama

A soft, cozy pyjama featuring the Arabic words “عيد مجيد” makes a thoughtful, festive gift for littles ones. Match it with a parent’s PJ for twice the cuddles.

Dardasha – Wooden Shapes Puzzle

A wooden Arabic shapes puzzle is a meaningful gift for play, learning, and cultural connection; a lovely way to introduce Arabic language at an early age. Bundle it with a bunny-themed storybook to complement the toy.

Little IA – Personalized Festive Christmas Stocking

A personalized Christmas stocking is a timeless, sentimental gift that’s perfect for babies and toddlers. It grows into a cherished keepsake that parents will save for years.

For babies, you can pair it with Sophie La Girafe Teether. As for toddlers, Crayola My First Chunky Crayons make a great stocking stuffer; they are perfect for little hands.

Little Yoga Socks – Grip Socks

Perfect for tiny toes and early steps. These cozy grip socks keep little feet warm while offering safe traction around the house. A practical and adorable stocking stuffer for babies and toddlers this holiday season.
